$comment: Registered exceptions to the rule that every job which can push shares
A waiver names the file and job, what the job pushes, and why that is
not a write to a spec branch that needs ordering against the stage runs
and the rebase. Every waiver is stale-checked: one naming a job that no
longer exists, or no longer pushes, fails the gate, so a waiver cannot
outlive its reason. A residual the waiver accepts is written down here,
in the open, with the issue that tracks it.

waivers.pushes: spec-draft/<NNN-slug>, through the agent's Bash(git push:*) grant
waivers.reason: No spec branch exists yet (specs/013 FR-005); the group is wing-commander-intake, one intake at a time.

waivers.pushes: nothing: it passes spec-dir "" to wing-commander-chain-stop-notice, whose mark-and-push branch is skipped when spec-dir is empty
waivers.reason: Same group as intake; no spec branch exists at this stage (specs/013 FR-005).

waivers.pushes: spec-draft/<NNN-slug>, through the agent's Bash(git push:*) grant
waivers.reason: The group is keyed to the lifecycle issue, not a spec branch (specs/013 FR-005); the spec branch spec/<NNN-slug> does not exist until the plan stage creates it.

waivers.pushes: a spec-meta stalled mark on spec/<NNN-slug> through wing-commander-chain-stop-notice, which cannot land: that branch does not exist until the plan stage creates it, so the composite reports the record unwritable
waivers.reason: Same issue-keyed group as clarify (specs/013 FR-005).

waivers.pushes: fold commits onto spec/<NNN-slug>, through the agent's Bash(git push:*) grant
waivers.reason: The group is computed by classify-and-announce: the per-spec group wing-commander-<spec-dir> for any run with a mutating leg, and a stop-only group for runs whose legs are all `stop` (specs/042 research.md D6, FR-015). A job-level expression that names a needs.* output is what the gate cannot read; the per-spec form is what it resolves to.
Not a spec branch; the composite serialises itself with fetch-rebase-push retries.

waivers.pushes: fix/<issue-number>-<slug>, a board-item branch, never a spec branch
waivers.reason: specs/057-autonomous-board-loop: the board loop works one issue at a time repository-wide under its own top-level concurrency (group: wing-commander-board-loop, cancel-in-progress: false), a stronger single-flight guarantee than the per-spec group. No spec/<NNN-slug> branch is ever touched.

waivers.pushes: a follow-up commit on the same fix/<issue-number>-<slug> board-item branch, never a spec branch
waivers.reason: Same top-level wing-commander-board-loop single-flight group as the fix job above (specs/057-autonomous-board-loop).

waivers.pushes: a scaffold onto the E2E test repository's default branch
waivers.reason: A different repository; no spec branch of this one is written.

waivers.pushes: the candidate scaffold and an agent-produced spec.md into the scratch repository
waivers.reason: A different repository; no spec branch of this one is written.

waivers.pushes: this repository's auto-update-spec-kit/<version> branch (the version-bump PR and its rollback)
waivers.reason: Its own branch, never a spec branch; one candidate at a time by the workflow's own tracking issue.
